label: Any correlation involving a sportsbook price or closing line
reason: No official NFL page reachable from this repository prints a price, so neither axis exists. A correlation with a line cannot be computed and its absence is published rather than assumed to be zero.
what_would_clear_it: A licensed price source whose terms permit storage, plus >= 100 graded fixtures with both a snapshot and an official result.

label: Player-prop to player-prop correlation (prop combos)
reason: No official NFL page publishes prop lines or prop outcomes as a joinable dataset; the league's own partners agreement places injury- and officiating-linked wagers inside its objectionable category.
what_would_clear_it: An officially sourced prop register with, for each pair, the joint outcome of both legs on the same fixture (>= 200 fixtures).

label: Injury designation to line movement
reason: Requires a designation time series and a price time series for the same fixture. Only one designation capture existed before this session and no price series exists at all.
what_would_clear_it: Two or more dated captures per week of the official report plus the price policy cleared; then n = fixtures x events, published per week.

label: Snap-count based depth to points allowed
reason: No official snap-count source is reachable, so depth has no measured playing-time axis to correlate.
what_would_clear_it: An official snap-count or inactives source covering all 32 clubs.
